crossRefs.note: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he…
Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might…
When they had tied him up with thongs, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man…
When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this…
The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,
and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

people.name: Rome
people.line: Capital city of the Roman Empire

translations.web: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.
translations.bsb: At once those who were about to interrogate Paul stepped back, and the commander himself was alarmed when he realized that he had put a Roman citizen in chains.
translations.kjv: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
translations.asv: They then that were about to examine him straightway departed from him: and the chief captain also was afraid when he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
